summary: Retested the fix for the driver-matching 500 and the AvailabilityPicker/driver dashboard fixes. Backend: test_iter20_availability.py passes 15/15. The new test_iter21_matching_availability.py passes 14/14. It covers the exact start and end window boundaries (match), overrun and before-window (no match), another date (no match), fallback to days/start_time/end_time for drivers with no or empty availability, POST /hire/requests to a window driver followed by accept (200), has_clash excluding the driver for an overlapping slot after a confirmed booking while a non-overlapping slot still matches, and a broadcast request dispatching to the fallback driver but not to the out-of-window driver. backend.err.log has no new TypeErrors; the earlier ones are from iter20. UI at 390x844: on /hire/driver, '9:00'-'17:30' is normalised and saved (Saved toast, shown as 9:00 AM - 5:30 PM, persists after reload). 'ab' shows 'Enter times as HH:MM, e.g. 09:00' and no card is added. A save forced to fail (PUT /pro/settings intercepted with 400) shows the error toast and leaves no phantom card, because the list reloads from the server. Edit (prefilled 09:00/17:30, changed to 7:15-11:45) and delete persist after reload. /hire/register (new TEST user) renders with no 'reading length' crash, and add, overlap error, garbage error, edit and delete all work. The /hire Rent a Driver search (passenger, Hiriyur, 4 Dec 10:00 x2h) calls /hire/local-drivers with a 200 and lists the TEST_Avail19 window driver. No console or page errors.

minor.issue: Uses a['date'] (KeyError if a legacy availability item has no 'date'). availability_snapshot guards new writes, so this only affects old docs. Prefer a.get('date').
Does not cross-check a['date'] against the date of from/to, does not reject duplicate ids, and regenerates created_at on every save.

issues: The label above Add Availability still reads 'Available days'. Suggest 'Availability dates' (carried over).
The query sends days=2 for an hourly booking. It is harmless but noisy.

action_items: Optional: use a.get('date') in eligible_local_drivers. Rename the 'Available days' label. Add a delete confirmation.
critical_code_review_comments: iso_dt() makes datetimes IST-aware, so the naive/aware 500 is fixed.
has_clash now checks only confirmed/started hires.
server.py is ~3700 lines and should be split into hire/pro modules.
seed_data_creation: TEST_ users only: pytest drivers and passengers (self-cleaned), TEST_Avail19 (via ui_setup_iter19_avail.py) and TEST_Reg21UI. All were deleted by user_id. The demo passenger only ran a search and created no request.
